column1: Proof of Calm tax-year file · United Kingdom · 2026-04-06 to 2027-04-05
Data from your log. Not a tax computation.
Amounts are as you logged them and are not converted. Your pay currency is GBP.

Rules for United Kingdom reviewed on 2026-11-05 · general information, not advice · Sources: https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/cryptoassets-manual/crypto22200, https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/cryptoassets-manual/crypto22100
Sales are not matched to purchases in this file; the pooling or matching is for your accountant.
One section 104 pool per token type, after the same-day rule and the 30-day rule (TCGA 1992 ss. 104, 105, and 106A). Proof of Calm lists each purchase and leaves the pooling to the accountant.
For a coin sold in the tax year, every purchase and sale to 2027-04-05 is listed for the pool, and the purchases to 2027-05-05 for the 30-day rule.
Made on 2026-10-20: purchases after that day are not in this file.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; amounts and units use a decimal point.
The tax year ends on 2027-04-05; this file shows your log as of 2026-10-20.
